senses.example: Coge el paraguas, que está lloviendo.
senses.exampleGloss: Take the umbrella, it is raining.

alternatives.reason: For sun, not rain; same shape, opposite weather.
Worn instead of carried; a rain item worth knowing.
Where the umbrella lives by the door; a household near-miss.

notes: paraguas is el even though it is plural in form; useful irregular gender point but not a grammar-only word.
